params.body:
## Summary
- PR #437 put "Voorstellen aan relatie" behind `config('features.relation_proposals')` (env `RELATION_PROPOSALS`, default off): entry points hidden, `GET/POST /vehicles/{id}/propose` → 404.
- Shane's decision now: keep it off for dealers, but on for platform admins, who already use every function of the app.
- Adds one gate, `App\Support\Features::relationProposals(?User $user)` (config flag OR `User::isAdmin()`, role BEHEERDER), and uses it everywhere PR #437 checked the flag directly: the controller's 404 guard, the own-stock row `⋯`-menu entry, and the buybox button. The `proposePrice` Alpine registration in `layouts/app.blade.php` was already unconditional, so nothing changes there.
- Updates the open point `docs/bedrijfsregels/open-punten/2026-09-15-voorstellen-aan-relatie-nieuwe-formule.md` and rule R S4-2.19 to note admins already have it.

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'Proposal|Propose|OwnStockRowMarkup|Buybox|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity'` — 54 tests, 262 assertions, green. Extends `VehicleProposalTest` and `ProposalPublicPageTest` with: flag off + dealer → hidden/404, flag off + admin → visible/200, flag on → visible for all (existing coverage, untouched).
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'AlpineExpressionTest|HandlerWiringTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest'` — 12 tests, 739 assertions, green.
params.title: Relation proposals: on for admins, still off for dealers
